hook: "Fashion brands don't just need beautiful clothes. They need content that helps people imagine themselves wearing them."
cta: "If you're a fashion brand looking to create content like this, let's talk." — service pitch.
idea: AI lets fashion brands show styling (how to wear each piece), occasions, and on-person looks — content that helps customers imagine themselves wearing it, not just another product photo.
sequencing: Hook: brands need imagine-yourself content, not just beautiful clothes.
The alternative: styling guides, occasions, on-real-person.
The enabler: AI makes this possible.
formatting: Service-pitch post: the insight → the AI-enabled alternative → the content promise → 28s video.
why_it_works: 'Imagine themselves wearing them' names the exact mental simulation that precedes purchase. AI as the enabler removes the photoshoot cost objection.
what_to_steal: The 'imagine themselves wearing it' principle as LC's styling-content thesis: every LC piece gets occasion-styling content (date night, gym, office) on AI models — 'how to wear' beats 'what it looks like.'

hook: "As a fashion vendor, you could simply put your outfits on a mannequin, or you could show potential customers what those same pieces actually look like on a person."
cta: none explicit — the capability pitch is the content.
idea: An AI influencer lets fashion vendors show pieces on a person and styled — no photoshoots, models, or locations — for polished, consistent brand content.
sequencing: The step further: show exactly how to style them.
The solution: your own AI influencer.
The payoff: polished, consistent, clean brand identity.
formatting: Vendor-pitch post: mannequin vs on-person contrast → the styling step further → the AI influencer solution. 27s video.
why_it_works: The mannequin contrast is visceral — everyone knows mannequin content underperforms. 'Your own AI influencer' makes the solution feel owned, not rented.
what_to_steal: The mannequin-vs-person contrast for LC's content audit: every flat jewelry shot should have an on-body styled version. The AI influencer as LC's always-on styling model — consistent face, infinite outfits, zero shoot costs.
